description: In a world that never stops, what truly matters often whispers. Explore The Noise Paradox with TEDxNITKSurathkal — ideas, people and perspectives that bring clarity to the noise.

registration.message: Registration for The Noise Paradox is open.

speakers.name: Smitha Murthy
speakers.title: Co-Founder, MyndStories
speakers.description: Smitha, co-founder of MyndStories, is a writer and speaker passionate about mental health, storytelling, and creating meaningful human connections.

speakers.name: Ramya Ranganathan
speakers.title: Corporate Trainer & Adjunct Faculty, IIMB
speakers.description: Top 15 Innovators in Higher Education recognized by the Ministry of Education. She helps individuals unlock their potential through personal growth and happiness-focused programs.

speakers.name: Rohit Agrawal
speakers.title: Senior Faculty at Physics Wallah (PW)
speakers.description: A renowned Organic Chemistry educator, he taught at Allen, co-founded Nucleus Education, and led Organic Chemistry at Physics Wallah.

speakers.name: Anuj Agrawal
speakers.title: Founder & CEO of Zyoin Group & Workplace
speakers.description: He helps businesses scale through talent solutions, GCC development, strategic partnerships, and startup investments.

speakers.name: Saptarshi Prakash
speakers.title: VP of Design at Swiggy, Content Creator
speakers.description: He leads design at Swiggy and is a speaker, author, and product design expert exploring the intersection of design, technology, and AI, with 700k followers as a content creator.

speakers.name: Akash Raj
speakers.title: AI Product Manager and Content Creator
speakers.description: AI Product Manager at Tiramai AI, founder of Military Mantra and Super Dream Foundation, building impactful products, communities, and social change.

stages.name: Distraction
stages.description: An endless stream of information. A thousand things asking for our attention.

stages.name: Overload
stages.description: More voices. More choices. Somewhere in the rush, meaning becomes harder to find.

stages.name: Reflection
stages.description: We pause. We question. We listen closely enough to notice a different perspective.

stages.name: Clarity
stages.description: The noise settles. An idea resonates. A quieter, stronger signal begins to emerge.
